liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls the Stella Blue into Not Fade Away sweet; Heartfelt Stella Blue keeps seeming to turn into Not Fade Away, yet remains Stella, a creative, ambiguous transition [11][12][13][18]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer found Row Jimmy a bit too slow, as well as They Love Each Other [11]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Lazy Lightning>Supplication judged one of the best of 1978 [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Blazing Scarlet>Fire, liked as much as the Giants Stadium one before the Egypt trip [14]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): In Not Fade Away, Garcia steps back and restrains himself, taking his time with small solo patterns [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-12-19.156949.54p.wgner.miller.flac2496** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The start of Mississippi Half-Step is missing, and the tape was flipped near the end of Drums [1]
- **gd1978-12-19.121941.sony54p.wagner.miller.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: The beginning of Mississippi Half-Step is missing from this recording [3]
- **gd78-12-19.aud-sony.wagner.19507.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 188 min; rated 4.56/5 by 27 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording sounds very good, though the bass seems lost, as on most audience tapes; Compared with other online Grateful Dead audience downloads, this one sounds really good [15][17]
- **gd78-12-19.sony.barrick.305.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 188 min; rated 4/5 by 9 [7]. Said about its sound: The tape jam missed the start of Mississippi Half-Step; Sound drops during Lazy Lightning>Supplication and mics are close to clapping; clarity is otherwise exceptional for pre-keyboard-era audience tapes [11][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer suggests the band booked southern December shows to stay warm, and they energized the Jackson crowd [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-12-19.156949.54p.wgner.miller.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Transfer and Mastering by Charlie Miller  May 24, 2022; source: (FOB) Sony 54P > Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD/Maxell UDXLII-C90) [1]. Also: Transferred from Bob Wagner's masters, with pitch correction by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1978-12-19.121941.sony54p.wagner.miller.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony 54P -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD) [3]. Also: Made from Bob Wagner's masters, with Joe B. Jones helping on pitch correction; disc changes are seamless [3]
- **gd78-12-19.aud-sony.wagner.19507.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Bob Wagner; source: Audience Recording: Sony 54-P [5]. Also: Reviewer points out that no soundboard exists for this show, so the audience tape is the only source [16]
- **gd78-12-19.sony.barrick.305.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording: Sony 540 [7]. Also: This archive copy comes from the same source as the reviewer's old cassette, minus the many cassette generations [10]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_41.html) [22]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1978-12-19 Memorial Coliseum, Mississippi State Fairgrounds, Jackson, MS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-12-19-memorial-coliseum-mississippi-state-fairgrounds-jackson-ms-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead of the Day: [December 19, 1978](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/12-19-1978/) [24]
